text:
incident-bot: ALERT: increased 429s for /v1/generate across us-east-1. paging oncall: ryan-oncall.

ryan-oncall: got it. seeing burst from a handful of tenants, latency creeping up. paging in now. @alice.sre are you online? :wave:

alice.sre: here. looking at SLO dashboards — p50 ok, p95 and p99 spiking. error breakdown shows 'rate_limit_exceeded' and a small spike of timeouts.

stella-sdk: heads up — a few customers reported retries causing duplicate downstream ops. we should advise client changes asap (idempotency + windowed backoff).

ryan-oncall: agree. short plan: 1) emergency live mitigation (server-side) to protect cluster 2) coordinated SDK guidance for clients to reduce pressure 3) handoff if needed. performing mitigation step 1 now.

jamal: what are you toggling server-side? rate limits? feature disables?

ryan-oncall: applying progressive rate limit: global soft cap at 120r/s -> 80r/s for non-authenticated free tier, burst window shrink from 10s->3s. also enabling temporary quota deductions for top noisy tenants (non-destructive). will hold streaming endpoints at lower concurrency.

ops-bot: ACTION: applied rate-limit policy "emergency-shape-1768000001" to gateway in us-east-1.

maria-pm: quick question — any customer-impact notices going out? priority customers first?

ryan-oncall: yes — we'll target noisy tenants first, then a broader advisory to customers if this continues. @stella-sdk can you draft short client-side guidance we can paste into status and share with Support?

stella-sdk: on it. initial guidance below (short + copyable):
- Honor 429s: implement exponential backoff with jitter.
- Make requests idempotent where possible (Idempotency-Key header).
- If using streaming, fall back to polling for retries (do not re-open same stream).
- Respect Retry-After header and server-suggested throttling.

stella-sdk: sample pseudocode (minimal):
```
max_retries = 6
base = 0.2  # seconds
for attempt in range(max_retries):
    resp = client.call(payload, idempotency_key=uuid())
    if resp.status == 200:
        break
    if resp.status == 429:
        backoff = base * (2 ** attempt) + random.uniform(0, base)
        sleep(min(backoff, 10))
        continue
    if resp.status in [502, 503, 504]:
        # transient, similar backoff
        sleep(base * (2 ** attempt))
        continue
```

stella-sdk: idempotency guidance: use a stable client-generated UUID per logical operation. servers will dedupe within 24h. header: `Idempotency-Key: <uuid>`

alice.sre: for streaming clients, add: if you get a 429 while streaming, close stream and retry with a new idempotency key and exponential backoff. Do not replay partial streaming tokens.

jamal: also recommend bounded retries and circuit-breaker: max 6 attempts, after 3 immediate failures consider adding a 30s cool-off and alerting users.

stella-sdk: agree. will add jittering strategy: full jitter recommended to avoid synchronized retries. example: `sleep = random.uniform(0, base * 2 ** attempt)`

ryan-oncall: good. ops note: disabling non-critical features — we've turned off realtime debug logs and non-essential webhook deliveries for 10m to reduce I/O.

ops-bot: ACTION: paused webhook fanout for "analytics-lite" consumers until 1768000060.

maria-pm: support: can we give a snippet for customers to reduce call rate from their side quickly? e.g., client-side token bucket change?

stella-sdk: short snippet for customers: throttle at client-side to 50r/s per API key, add random jitter when retrying, and include Idempotency-Key header.

Copyable: `if rate > 50: sleep(0.02 * random())`

tony-eng: infra note — we should also expose a temporary header to communicate shaping window: `X-RW-Shape: <tier>:<window_s>` so SDKs can adapt quickly. ops can toggle.

ryan-oncall: ops, can you add that header?

ops-bot: ACTION: header `X-RW-Shape` added to 429 responses with value `softcap:3`. live starting now.

stella-sdk: we'll update SDKs to log `X-RW-Shape` and surface it in telemetry for customers. quick rollout: patch on all languages in next 40m with light docs.

alice.sre: customer impact assessment so far: 1) ~15% of requests from top 8 tenants are being soft-throttled, expected increase in user-visible latency up to +2s while backoff occurs. 2) no data loss observed. 3) some customers on old clients may see duplicate operations without idempotency.

maria-pm: recommend customer comms: short status update + recommended SDK patch and mitigation steps. label high-risk customers and loop in account teams.

ryan-oncall: handoff plan: I'm going to monitor next 20m, then hand to alice if still ongoing. action items:
- ryan-oncall: monitor infra, escalate if error rate not trending down in 15m
- stella-sdk: publish short SDK advisory + snippets to Support channel (ETA 15m)
- jamal: prepare rollback plan to relax shape if backoff causes downstream issues (ETA 10m)
- ops-bot: keep header & policies in place and log metrics every 1m

stella-sdk: posted advisory to #support-snippets and opened GH issue for SDK patch: https://github.com/redwood/sdk/issues/489

jamal: I'm prepping a temporary per-tenant quota tweak endpoint in case a customer needs immediate relief: `PATCH /admin/tenant/:id/quota` — will coordinate with Account.

alice.sre: I'll take over monitoring at T+20m and coordinate Customer Success for any urgent escalations. please drop any new symptoms here.

ryan-oncall: thanks team. initial metrics look better — 429s down 30% in last 4m. will report back at T+20m or earlier. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied. 429 rate decreased. next update scheduled in 20 minutes.

stella-sdk: follow-up note for Support to paste into customer replies: 
"We're seeing elevated throttling in us-east-1. To reduce impact, please update your client to honor 429 + Retry-After, include an Idempotency-Key for mutating requests, and add exponential backoff with jitter. If you need rate increases for a short window, contact your account team; do not retry aggressively."
